claim_checks.claim: Perched on elevated platforms overlooking the Serengeti plains
claim_checks.note: Elevated wooden walkways connect rooms and facilities, and the lodge overlooks the plains.

claim_checks.claim: Sits in the heart of the Serengeti ecosystem
claim_checks.note: Central Serengeti, inside Serengeti National Park (a UNESCO World Heritage Site).

claim_checks.claim: Great Migration of over 2 million wildebeest, zebras and gazelles
claim_checks.note: About 1.7 million wildebeest, 260,000 zebras and about 470,000 gazelles, so 'over 2 million animals' combined is accurate. 'Over 2 million wildebeest' would be wrong.
A review mentions glass walls in the architecture. Floor-to-ceiling windows in every room were not confirmed.

claim_checks.claim: Private decks positioned for wildlife viewing from your room
claim_checks.note: All categories have terraces or balconies. Horizon rooms look onto the waterhole, and Terrace Suites have plunge pools.

claim_checks.claim: Elevated walkways keep you safely above the action while lions, elephants and leopards roam freely below
claim_checks.note: Elephants do visit the waterhole by the pool. However, the lodge uses strategic fencing and Maasai security, and big cats roaming beneath the walkways was not confirmed.

claim_checks.claim: Calving season January-March on the southern plains
claim_checks.note: Calving happens on the south-eastern short-grass plains (Ndutu area), late January to March, peaking in February.

claim_checks.claim: Calving draws predators 'right outside your suite'
claim_checks.note: The lodge is in central Serengeti (Seronera). The calving grounds are on the southern plains, so guests reach them by long game drives. Migration herds pass the central area mainly around May-June and November-December.

claim_checks.claim: Sunrise hot-air balloon safari with champagne bush breakfast
claim_checks.note: Available as a paid add-on (about $500-600 per person per this review). It must be booked in advance.

claim_checks.claim: Infinity pool where giraffes and zebras graze at the horizon
claim_checks.note: The infinity pool overlooks an active waterhole. The animals documented there are elephants (also waterbuck, buffalo and gazelles), not specifically giraffes and zebras.

claim_checks.claim: Boma dinner under the stars with traditional Maasai entertainment around a fire
claim_checks.note: Boma Grill offers Maasai-inspired meals around an open fire, about once or twice weekly. The press fact sheet lists it as having 45 indoor seats.

claim_checks.claim: Expertly guided game drives and cultural experiences
claim_checks.note: Guide services, walking safaris and a Discovery Centre with museum exhibits and a lecture hall.
Most of the 77 keys are rooms (60), not suites. There are 12 suites and 5 villas.

Access is by light-aircraft flight from Arusha to Seronera Airstrip (about 50 minutes) and then about a 50-minute drive. Guests can also drive from Arusha (about 8 hours). A private charter is not required.

claim_checks.claim: Seasonal migration patterns affect game viewing
claim_checks.note: Herds pass central Serengeti mainly May-June and November-December. Resident predators are present year-round, and northern river crossings are not reachable from here.

facts.text: Opened December 2012 with 77 keys: 60 rooms, 12 suites and 5 freestanding villas.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Safari Lodge Serengeti fact sheet

facts.text: Located in central Serengeti National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - fact sheet

facts.text: Access is a roughly 50-minute flight from Arusha to Seronera Airstrip (SEU), then about 50 minutes by Land Cruiser. Driving from Arusha via Ngorongoro and Naabi Gate takes about 8 hours.
facts.source_title: Five Star Alliance - Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti

facts.text: An outdoor infinity pool overlooks an active waterhole frequented by elephants, next to the Maji Bar.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - fact sheet

facts.text: Dining: Kula's Restaurant (African-inspired and international), Boma Grill (African, fire-side), Maji Bar, Sundowner Bar and The Vineyard wine room.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - fact sheet

facts.text: Serengeti Kani Spa has six treatment pavilions; the signature treatment is the 90-minute Kifa Massage.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - fact sheet

facts.text: The Discovery Centre has museum-quality exhibits and a lecture hall on local wildlife, environment and culture.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - fact sheet

facts.text: Kijana Klub is a kids' and teens' programme with Maasai guides and wildlife experts.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - fact sheet

facts.text: Elevated wooden walkways link the rooms, and Maasai staff form the security team.
facts.source_title: Five Star Alliance - Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti

facts.text: Terrace Suites have private infinity plunge pools. Horizon Rooms face the waterhole.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti Review 2026

facts.text: The Great Migration totals about 1.7 million wildebeest, 260,000 zebras and 470,000 gazelles. Calving is on the south-eastern short-grass plains in February.
Named in Travel + Leisure's World's Top 100 Hotels (2019).
facts.source_title: Five Star Alliance - Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti

considerations.text: Migration herds pass central Serengeti mainly around May-June and November-December. February calving (Ndutu and the southern plains) and northern river crossings require long drives or a different camp.
considerations.source_title: Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti Review 2026

considerations.text: The lodge is in the public national park, not a private concession, so game drives share roads with other vehicles at popular sightings.
considerations.source_title: Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti Review 2026

considerations.text: Getting there takes a light-aircraft flight to Seronera plus about a 50-minute drive, or roughly 8 hours by road from Arusha.
considerations.source_title: Five Star Alliance - Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti

considerations.text: Hot-air balloon safaris cost extra (about $500-600 per person per one review) and must be pre-booked.
considerations.source_title: Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti Review 2026

considerations.text: Wildlife is close: elephants drink at the waterhole next to the pool, and movement around the lodge is on elevated walkways with Maasai security.
considerations.source_title: Five Star Alliance - Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti

best_for: Families on a first safari: Kijana Klub, the Discovery Centre and two-bedroom villas.
Travellers who want resort comforts in the bush: infinity pool over an elephant waterhole, a six-pavilion spa and several restaurants.
Wildlife lovers visiting in May-June or November-December, when migration herds pass central Serengeti and resident predators are present year-round.
